subject: Evening Inference Jam — bridge session & breakout plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@stellarretail.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@acmecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@glidehealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening Inference Jam — bridge session & breakout plan

Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a joint evening session where we’ll demo a short throughput + latency run, then split into breakout tables by integration needs (API, private deployment, embeddings). Proposed plan:

- Welcome + 10m context from Redwood
- 20m live demo: hosted vs dedicated routing, batching effects
- 20m breakout rooms (3 tracks) + 10m wrap-up

Two candidate windows (please reply with preferred):
A) Wed Mar 22 — 5:00 PM PT / 8:00 PM ET
B) Thu Mar 23 — 7:30 PM PT / 10:30 PM ET

If you have a preference for a breakout track, add it in your reply — we’ll try to accommodate. I’ve attached a one-page agenda and a short host roster draft.

Attachments: 20280315-inference-jam-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai

--
Redwood Inference — Production-grade inference for teams

Thanks for organizing. B) Thu Mar 23 at 7:30 PM PT works best for our team (we're on PDT in SF). We’d like the breakout focused on "low-latency inference for catalog search" — two of our engineers will join.
